rule: its facts must fit its story

a dip alert, cash to spare:
a big dip in something I own
2 Claude Code reads my balance and holdings · 8 results feed the next report
One company's story, as you told it
Or it starts here: an IPO bought
Suggestions, not rules: nothing here is refused
• Watch a company before buying it. A buy off the list goes through and is marked.
• Buy at review time. A buy between reviews goes through and is marked.
• Stay within the paycheck plus spare cash. The report shows the total; nothing blocks it.
The only real rules: the story has to make sense
• An order is completed or expired only after it was requested.
• A company is followed once: one record per company.
• The broker's numbers win over mine; I record what I saw, and when.
Two models of the same routine
